result.summary: Тесты стали намного крепче: 165 тестов (55 + 14 + 96) зелёные пять раз подряд и каждый по отдельности, на чистой копии метки красны 11 охранных тестов, из 316 мутантов красными стали 301, а прибор критерия 7 укладывается в 94 секунды из 120. Шаг всё же не проходит (пункт 3 роли): правила «значение начинается с your», «цепочка из x, X, * - это всё значение» и «несколько пробелов после Authorization:» проверены только с одной стороны, и мутанты «your где угодно», «три x в начале достаточно», «после двоеточия пропускается один пробел» живут при 151 зелёном тесте, хотя настоящий код отклоняет такие строки правильно. Это дополнительный проход после трёх FAIL (решение 0102, дополнение 13), поэтому решает владелец: код чинить не нужно, нужны около двадцати строк в таблицах и три проверки по классу, остальные замечания Low не блокируют.

findings.where: tools/test/team-result-bytes.test.js: tables KEEP/REFUSE, PAIRS, SWEEPS (criterion 3, class Z of the requirement, the placeholder rules); role item 3, AP-110, AP-014
findings.what: Two rules of the class Z are held from one side only. (a) 'Starts with your': the sweeps Y0 (a character after your) and Y2 (a character before example) exist, but there is no row or sweep with a character BEFORE your, so the rule 'starts with' is not told from 'contains'. My mutant n67 (the test for your looks for the word anywhere in a value of the safe character set) stays green in the seven files (151 of 151 pass, 299 s under load) and in the fast subset RB-07/08/09/20. Real code and mutant differ on: password=Xyour9abc, token=myyourkey, password: 'Zyourz1', https://u:Zyour1@h (refused by the real code, stored by the mutant). The mutant for example as a prefix only (n68) is red, so the contains-half is held and the starts-with half is not. (b) 'A chain of at least 3 characters made only of *, x, X': the rows hold the whole chain (O21 xxx and XXX, O14 token=xxxxxxxx and ***) and too short chains (C22), but no chain followed by other characters. My mutant wd01 (a value is a placeholder when its first three characters are *, x or X) stays green in the seven files (151 of 151). Differs on: token=xxxhunter2fake, password=***abc, secret=XXXq1w2e3 (refused by the real code, stored by the mutant). This is the same class as F1 of the gate 08h ('the whole value is X': test the text before AND after X), now in the placeholder rules. A real secret that begins with three x or contains your in the middle of a word of the safe set would be stored by such a bug and no test would notice.
findings.fix: TEST-DESIGNER: (a) refused rows with the character before your in the three places (unquoted, in quotes, password of an address): password=Xyour9abc, token=myyourkey, password: 'Zyourz1', https://u:Zyour1@h, each paired with the stored row token=your-key (O54/O26); better by the class: one sweep with a slot before the word your (a letter, digit, _ . - before it makes the value a literal; a separator before it ends the value), like Y2 for example. (b) refused rows 'a chain followed by more characters' in the same three places: token=xxxhunter2fake, password=***abc, secret=XXXq1w2e3, password: 'xxxabc9', https://u:xxxQx7Rt2Lm9@h, paired with O21 password=xxx; better by the class: a sweep with a slot after xxx (stored only when the slot ends the value: white space, quote, comma, semicolon; unquoted and in quotes: the closing quote). Expected side from the words of the requirement ('starts with your', 'a chain only of *, x, X'), all rows run on the real code give the expected side. Then the mutants n67 and wd01 must be red; report red/green.
